items.title: Meshy wants AI for 3D creation to feel less like a prompt and more like a creative partner
items.excerpt: Rather than a one-shot generator, Meshy's new conversational 3D Agent keeps context across a chat so game artists can brainstorm, iterate, and batch-build style-consistent asset families before exporting production-ready, riggable models into existing pipelines -- positioning generative 3D as a creative collaborator rather than a prompt box.

items.title: Twitch streamer Ludwig appears as an NPC in a Chinese FMV game -- stuffed with AI slop
items.excerpt: The live-action FMV game Road To Empress II casts streamer Ludwig as an NPC, but leans on generative-AI 'slop' for much of its visuals and content -- a concrete case study in how (and how badly) gen-AI is being folded into shipped commercial titles and how players react. Marginal craft hook; adoption/reception context.

items.title: Desperate for Duskbloods news? AI chatbots will just make it up
items.excerpt: AI chatbots are confidently presenting Reddit shitposts as fact about FromSoftware's unreleased Switch 2 game The Duskbloods -- a look at how generative-AI hallucination is reshaping how players source game information. Weak design/craft hook; included as fresh, games-specific funnel context.
